Name: Eliab, Son of Jesse
Summary: Eliab, Jesse's eldest, was tall and kingly enough that Samuel thought him the Lord's anointed — but God refused him. He served in Saul's army and scorned David when the boy came to the camp at Elah.
KeyStory: Eliab looked like a king and sounded like a king, and God passed him over.
RelatedPeople: Jesse; King David; Abinadab, Son of Jesse; Shammah, Son of Jesse; Abihail, Daughter of Eliab
LifeLesson: God looks on the heart, not on height — and a brother's scorn cannot stop God's choice.
